{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Dress: A-line formal dress with a fitted bodice, softly V-neckline, wide straps, defined waist and a flowing skirt, ankle-length, in deep teal-green (#3F6B63), in silk crepe satin

Shoes: Block-heel ankle-strap sandals, medium heel, in warm champagne gold (#D9BF8F), in smooth satin-finish leather

Clutch: Small structured envelope clutch in soft gold (#C9A86A), in metallic-finish leather

Earrings: Medium drop earrings with a delicate open shape, in warm gold (#C9A86A), in polished metal

Why this outfit works: The silk crepe satin dress is a formal fabric that suits the wedding, and its ankle length keeps it elegant while the flowing skirt stays cool on a warm August afternoon. Bare arms are the only open zone, so the look stays refined and comfortable for an outdoor ceremony and the restaurant afterwards. The deep teal-green echoes the grey-green of your eyes and sets off your golden hair and warm skin, without competing with the bride. Block heels stay stable on grass, and the champagne-gold shoes and accessories add a festive glow that carries from daylight into the evening."}
